messages.subject: Re: setar() function
parts:
Dear Chibsi

I am glad the package can be useful for your thesis! Concerning your
question, you can find the definition in this document:
http://stat.ethz.ch/CRAN/web/packages/tsDyn/vignettes/tsDyn.pdf page 3.
If this is still not clear please let us know so we can improve the doc.

Note that in case of setar, one should use either d/steps or
mL/mH/ML/MH, both together might make it fail. Also, are you aware of
the package tseriesChaos for chaos theory?

I cced to the tsdyn mailing list. You can subscribe to it to ask further
questions, as well as to stay informed about new features. If you use
tsDyn for your master thesis, we would be happy to receive a copy when
finished and, even best, a link to your a permanent location so that we
can reference which papers used our package. For sure, we also
acknowledge when the package is cited also :-)

Hope this helps

Matthieu
